coverage.target: NFR7.1, NFR7.2, NFR7.3, NFR7.4, NFR7.5, NFR7.6, NFR7.7, NFR7.8, NFR7.9, NFR7.10, NFR7.11, NFR7.12, NFR7.13, NFR7.14
accessibility — this unit renders nothing. It is a spec unit with no runtime and no surface; WCAG 2.1 AA applies to u2-design-system and the five ui units
accessibility enforcement in CI — no rendered output exists here for an automated accessibility check to scan

per-locality contrast — this unit types visualStyling as an opaque map and deliberately never interprets a colour value; contrast validation belongs to u3-foundation's brand-token parsing and to whoever seeds brands
responsive behaviour — no layout, no breakpoints, no rendered output
perceived responsiveness — this unit executes nothing at run time, so it contributes no latency to any interaction
degraded connectivity — this unit makes no requests; loading, retry and rate-limited states belong to u3-foundation and the ui units that render them

test coverage floor — this unit's output is generated or transcribed code, excluded from the 80% floor by ADR-007. Its correctness is verified by review of the diff against api-documentation.md (NFR7.5) and by the scheduled regeneration check (NFR7.6), not by unit tests over generated types

browser support — types are erased before anything reaches a browser. The build target that governs emitted syntax is a stack-level concern owned by infrastructure-design, constrained here only by TS1-TS3
